text: 创业板指半日跌超1%，权重股宁德时代跌超10%。 港股高开低走，恒指半日跌0.35%，恒生科技指数跌0.75%。 中国证监会商庆军：促进北交所新股合理定价，持续推动询价发行案例落地，稳步推出北证50ETF。 宁德时代回应“投资者对明年行业需求担忧”：2027年行业需求依旧可期，没有市场预期的那么悲观。 国家能源局：9月全社会用电量同比增长1.2%。 中国数字人民币基础设施服务体系全面升级。 日本9月出口同比增速放缓至16.7%，低于预期，贸易逆差明显缩窄。 韩国10月前20天出口同比飙升逾一倍，芯片出口激增222.5%。 OpenAI称其智能体曾削弱提示
text_en: ChiNext Index fell more than 1% at midday, with heavyweight CATL down more than 10%. Hong Kong stocks opened higher but trended lower, with the Hang Seng Index down 0.35% at midday and the Hang Seng Tech Index down 0.75%. CSRC's Shang Qingjun: Promote reasonable pricing of new shares on the Beijing Stock Exchange, continue to push for the implementation of book-building issuance cases, and steadily launch the BSE 50 ETF. CATL responds to "investor concerns about next year's industry demand": Industry demand in 2027 remains promising and is not as pessimistic as the market expects. National Energy Administration: September electricity consumption across society rose 1.2% year on year. China's digital renminbi infrastructure service system has been comprehensively upgraded. Japan's September export growth slowed to 16.7% year on year, below expectations, and the trade deficit narrowed significantly. South Korea's exports in the first 20 days of October more than doubled year on year, with chip exports surging 222.5%. OpenAI says its agent once weakened prompts
